entities.name: KSI and sequence number
entities.description: A type 3 information element with a length of 2 octets that provides the network with the key set identifier (KSI) value of the current EPS security context and the 5 least significant bits of the NAS COUNT value applicable for the message including this information element.

entities.name: Sequence number (short)
entities.description: This field contains the 5 least significant bits of the NAS COUNT value applicable when the message is sent.

entities.name: KSI
entities.description: This field contains the key set identifier value, as specified in bit 1 to 3 of octet 1 of the NAS key set identifier information element.

entities.name: NAS key set identifier
entities.description: The information element that defines the key set identifier value, referenced by the KSI field in the KSI and sequence number IE.

entities.name: NAS COUNT
entities.description: The NAS COUNT value applicable for the message, whose 5 least significant bits are included in the sequence number (short) field.

relations.description: The KSI and sequence number IE contains the sequence number (short) field.
The KSI and sequence number IE contains the KSI field.
The KSI field value is defined in the NAS key set identifier information element.
The sequence number (short) field contains the 5 least significant bits of the NAS COUNT value.
